title: Passive Income SBD Grind Calculator for Ontario CCPCs

rows.section: Guide - Ontario Also Cut the Rate
rows.before: Ontario reduced its small business rate from 3.2% to 2.2% effective 1 July 2026, so the combined small business rate is now 11.2% rather than the 12.2% you will still see quoted almost everywhere.
rows.after: Ontario reduced its small business rate from 3.2% to 2.2% effective 1 July 2026, so the combined small business rate is now 11.2% rather than the 12.2% you will still see quoted almost everywhere.
rows.note: States 12.2%/3.2% only as the former rate replaced on July 1, 2026; already correct.
